title: GTA VI — city depth and connected streets
comparison: Layered buildings, completed roofs, planted streets, traffic, readable balconies and distant skyline. Match that density and material depth using Singapore forms.

title: GTA VI — light, vegetation and material separation
comparison: Warm directional light, varied vegetation, contact shadow, water and metal response, and coherent near-to-far detail. Judge equivalent lighting conditions rather than hiding unfinished work in darkness.

title: GTA VI — close character fidelity
comparison: Skin, hair, fabric, jewelry and expressive dimensional faces establish the close-view fidelity bar. Create original people; inspect our characters at comparable screen size.

title: Singapore — Joo Chiat street-level architecture
comparison: Narrow frontage rhythm, shutters, tiled roof ridges, relief ornament, deep entrances, gates, kerbs and everyday street fixtures. These need modeled depth and consistent human scale.

title: Singapore — inhabited hawker interior
comparison: Roof trusses, corrugated roofing, hanging fans, stall counters, practical lighting, communal tables and clear busy aisles. Recreate believable everyday activity and spatial depth, with original reviewed signage.

title: Singapore — waterfront scale and skyline
comparison: Waterfront setbacks, bridges, varied tower massing, green promenades, and low-rise foreground against the skyline. Helicopter views must reveal the same completed district that is playable on foot.
